# Data Source: appwrite_mongo_database

Fetches a dedicated Appwrite MongoDB database by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appwrite_mongo_database" "main" {
  id = "main"
}

output "database_host" {
  value = data.appwrite_mongo_database.main.hostname
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The database ID.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) The Appwrite project ID. Defaults to the provider-level project_id.

### Read-Only

- `api` (String) The product API that owns this database.
- `backend` (String) The database backend provider.
- `backup_enabled` (Boolean) Whether automatic backups are enabled.
- `connection_password` (String, Sensitive) The password to connect with.
- `connection_port` (Number) The port to connect to.
- `connection_string` (String, Sensitive) The full connection URI, including credentials.
- `connection_user` (String) The username to connect with.
- `container_status` (String) The container status for lifecycle-managed runtimes.
- `cpu` (Number) The allocated CPU in millicores.
- `created_at` (String) The database creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format.
- `engine` (String) The database engine reported by the server.
- `error` (String) The error message reported when the status is `failed`.
- `hostname` (String) The hostname to connect to.
- `idle_timeout_minutes` (Number) Minutes of inactivity before the container scales to zero.
- `idle_until` (String) When the database is expected to be considered idle.
- `last_accessed_at` (String) The last activity timestamp in ISO 8601 format.
- `lifecycle_state` (String) The idle-lifecycle state.
- `maintenance_window_day` (String) The day of the week the maintenance window starts.
- `maintenance_window_hour_utc` (Number) The hour in UTC the maintenance window starts.
- `memory` (Number) The allocated memory in MB.
- `metrics_enabled` (Boolean) Whether metrics collection is enabled.
- `name` (String) The database display name.
- `network_idle_timeout_seconds` (Number) The idle client connection timeout in seconds.
- `network_ip_allowlist` (Set of String) The IP addresses and CIDR ranges allowed to connect.
- `network_max_connections` (Number) The maximum number of concurrent client connections.
- `node_pool` (String) The node pool the database is scheduled on.
- `pitr` (Boolean) Whether point-in-time recovery is enabled.
- `pitr_retention_days` (Number) How many days of point-in-time recovery data are retained.
- `replicas` (Number) The number of high availability replicas.
- `specification` (String) The compute specification slug.
- `sql_api_allowed_statements` (Set of String) The statement types the SQL API accepts.
- `sql_api_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the SQL API sidecar is enabled.
- `sql_api_max_bytes` (Number) The maximum SQL API result payload in bytes.
- `sql_api_max_rows` (Number) The maximum rows returned per SQL API execution.
- `sql_api_timeout_seconds` (Number) The maximum SQL API execution time in seconds.
- `ssl` (Boolean) Whether SSL/TLS is required for client connections.
- `status` (String) The database status.
- `storage` (Number) The allocated storage in GB.
- `storage_autoscaling` (Boolean) Whether storage expands automatically.
- `storage_autoscaling_max_gb` (Number) The storage ceiling in GB for autoscaling. 0 means no limit.
- `storage_autoscaling_threshold_percent` (Number) The usage percentage that triggers automatic expansion.
- `storage_class` (String) The storage class backing the volume.
- `storage_max_gb` (Number) The maximum storage allowed in GB.
- `sync_mode` (String) The replication sync mode.
- `updated_at` (String) The database last update timestamp in ISO 8601 format.
- `version` (String) The database engine version.
